verdict.rationale: Exa's Websets API docs state you can 'get real-time HTTP callbacks as items are added or enriched'. Scheduled searches (monitors) also surface new events, so subscribing to events via webhooks is documented. The support appears limited to the Websets product and rests on a single brief line, with no detail on event types, payloads, or delivery guarantees. Missing for 10: documented webhook event catalog and payload schema, signature verification and retry/delivery semantics, webhook coverage beyond Websets (e.g. search or agent runs), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
